summary: Black Hawk Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K to report issuing a convertible promissory note to its sponsor, Black Hawk Management LLC. The note allows advances up to $300,000 for working capital and extension fees, bearing 10% annual interest. Repayment occurs at a DeSPAC closing or liquidation; in a DeSPAC, the sponsor may convert principal into post-merger shares at $1.00 per share. The note is unsecured and the sponsor waived trust account claims. Issuance relied on Section 4(a)(2) exemption. This is routine SPAC working capital financing, not a special-situation event; no control change, premium, or strategic decision involved. Watch for future DeSPAC announcement.
